tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand the service purpose, domain mapping, current layout, and known gaps.

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: Follow the composition root as it loads configuration, creates the PostgreSQL pool, constructs repositories and services, mounts routes, and starts the server.

tour.title: HTTP Request Flow
tour.description: Inspect the router, middleware, and handlers that turn authenticated HTTP requests into user and debt service calls.

tour.title: Domain Services
tour.description: Read the user and debt entities and services to see the current vertical slice boundaries and business operations.

tour.title: Persistence Boundary
tour.description: Trace repositories into sqlc generated code and SQL query sources, then compare the implementation with the configured generation layout.

tour.title: Database Schema and Local Runtime
tour.description: Review migrations and Docker Compose to understand the PostgreSQL schema and local development environment.

tour.title: API Documentation and Static Assets
tour.description: Finish with generated Swagger assets and the static page served alongside the API.
